import subprocess,sys,time,re
bb=sys.argv[1]
c=subprocess.Popen(["sleep","20"],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
time.sleep(0.25)
try:
 args=[bb,"lsof"]+sys.argv[2:]
 out=subprocess.run(args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=5).stdout.decode("utf8","replace")
 for line in out.splitlines():
  if line.startswith(str(c.pid)+"\t"): print(re.sub(r"^\d+\t","<PID>\t",line))
finally:
 c.terminate(); c.wait()
